summary: Phase 2 Batch 2A.3 close-out verification (frontend only). Ran the required Jest suites (caseStudyGate, legacyRedirect, previewGate) - all 22 tests pass. Verified via Playwright against preview host that CASE_STUDY_PUBLIC=false correctly hides every /case-study/ anchor on Home, Services, CRV, Safety Walkthrough, and /walkthrough. All gated data-testids (recent-engagement-section, case-study-column, cost-scenario-cta, case-study-teaser-*, crv-social-proof, wt-social-proof-section) are absent from the DOM. Canonical /case-study/metal-fabrication-readiness redirects to /resources without ?preview=1. Both legacy URLs (/case-study/metals-fabrication-statesville and /case-studies/mocksville-plastics-osha-inspection) redirect via Navigate through the canonical to /resources. With ?preview=1 the case study renders; case-top-cta block has the correct link href (/intake?service=compliance-readiness-visit&utm_source=case-study&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=case-top-cta), correct visible text ('Request a Compliance Readiness Visit'), and the tagline containing both 'Starting at $2,500' and 'Saves $500'. Old copy ('Request a Walkthrough Like This' and 'From $1,300') is not present anywhere on the page.
critical_code_review_comments: CaseStudyMetalsFabricationPage.js is ~890 lines; consider splitting the Finding/FAQItem/StatItem subcomponents into separate files for maintainability (>700 line threshold).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch 2A.3 verified end-to-end. When CASE_STUDY_PUBLIC is eventually flipped to true, re-verify Home/Services/CRV/Walkthrough now render the previously-hidden testids and case-study links. Preview bypass path (?preview=1) is exercised only on preview host - production refuses it by design.
